excerpt: SuperKEKB, a 7 GeV electron - 4 GeV positron double-ring collider, is constructed by upgrading KEKB in order to seek new physics beyond the Standard Model. The design luminosity of SuperKEKB is 8 x 10^35 /cm^2 /s - 40 times higher than that achieved by KEKB.
publisher: K. Akai, K. Furukawa, H. Koiso / Nuclear Instruments and Methods A
title: SuperKEKB Collider
